description: This file defines an interface 'QueryCommandResponseAdapter' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter', which serves as a mixin for handling retrieve command responses. It extends a generic 'Adapter' for command responses and provides default implementations for retrieving criteria, actions, and response applicability.

classes.name: QueryCommandResponseAdapter
classes.description: An interface acting as a mixin for retrieve command responses, providing default criteria, actions, and response indication for command response adapters.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of criteria indicating this adapter handles command responses, specifically the COMMANDS criterion.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the set of actions, specifically RETRIEVE, indicating this adapter is for retrieve operations.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether the adapter is intended for command responses; returns true.
